conf.description: Trellix ePO DLP Endpoint incident, syslog-cef: Automatic Response renders a DLP incident through ePO's own threat-event CEF envelope (a summary, not the incident record) - parsed with regex_extract, never the cef function, which only serializes.

conf.comment: This is the ePO threat-event envelope, not the DLP incident schema - use for low-latency alerting only; the jdbc-sql pipeline is the record to investigate against and must win any dedup. Assumes upstream routing already selected DLP-branch (ThreatCategory/ThreatEventID) records; no Route logic here.

functions.description: flag why this format is a latency shortcut, not the authoritative record
split the pipe-delimited CEF header from the space-delimited key=value extension blob

conf.regex: /DetectedUTC=(?<DetectedUTC>.*?) ReceivedUTC=(?<ReceivedUTC>.*?) ThreatEventID=(?<ThreatEventID>.*?) ThreatCategory=(?<ThreatCategory>.*?) ThreatName=(?<ThreatName>.*?) ThreatSeverity=(?<ThreatSeverity>.*?) ThreatActionTaken=(?<ThreatActionTaken>.*?) ThreatHandled=(?<ThreatHandled>.*?) AnalyzerName=(?<AnalyzerName>.*?) TargetHostName=(?<TargetHostName>.*?) TargetIPV4=(?<TargetIPV4>.*?) TargetUserName=(?<TargetUserName>.*?) SourceUserName=(?<SourceUserName>.*?) SourceProcessName=(?<SourceProcessName>.*?) TargetFileName=(?<TargetFileName>.*?) SourceURL=(?<SourceURL>.*)$/

functions.description: extract all 16 named extension keys in one pass, each bounded by the literal next key, so a value containing an unescaped space (AnalyzerName, ThreatName, file/process paths) is captured whole instead of truncated by a naive kv split
compute derived fields from the original extension key names before rename nests them, per the compute-before-rename order; drop the raw keys consumed here (CEF header fields kept as an audit trail)
batch every clean-identifier extension key into its ECS or vendor-namespace target; event.action here is left as the raw undecoded IDS_ALERT_ACT_TAK_* key - see README gap
tag the Elastic data-stream dataset component (hyphens replaced with underscores) - same value as the jdbc-sql format so the two land in one data stream
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
